question: The Gayathri Mantra is the most reversed Vedic Mantra in Hinduism. Which Vedic Sage is considered as the author of Gayathri Mantra?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 76/2025 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 30 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Sage Viswamitra.

question: Which among the individuals were bestowed Jnanapith Award for the year 2023 ? I. Assamese poet Nilmani Phookan. II. Sanskrit scholar Ramabhadracharya. III. Konkani author damodar mayzo. IV. Urdu poet Gulzar.
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 044/2024 (Assistant, 23 Apr 2024). The correct answer is II, IV.

question: Match list – 1 of awardees with list – 2 of categories in 67th National Film Awards : List – 1 (Awardee) List – 2 (Category) a. Vijay Sethupathy 1. Best Actor b. manoj Bajpayee 2. Best Supporting Actor c. mathukutty Xavier 3. Best director d. Sanjay Puran Singh 4. Best debut Film of a director Codes : a b c d
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 097/2021 (HSST Journalism, 29 Sep 2021). The correct answer is 2 1 4 3.

question: Which of the following malayalam screenplay is not included in m. T. Vasudevan Nair ? i. Nagaramenandi ii. Anandaram iii. Kochuthemmadai iv. Nizhalattam
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 63/2025 (Technical Assistant Gr II, 12 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only ii.

question: What is the name of the dome above the central hall of the Golden Temple?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 182/2024 (Jr. Instructor, 23 Dec 2024). The correct answer is Fluted Dome.
